changes.to: The maker's site (yqbionics.com) served only an empty stub on 2026-11-17 and no maker page or datasheet with figures could be read, so the record stays unconfirmed with its spec fields empty. Catalogue and exhibition pages describe X-Bot as a 167 cm, 60 kg biped with 51 DoF, 20 kg payload and 340 Nm peak joint torque; those values are not maker-verified here.
Yue Quan Bionics' full-size bipedal humanoid (Boxing X-Bot) for research and industrial work.
